episodes.title: El chico invisible
episodes.summary: Capi suffers a terrible accident that leaves him with PTSD and the power of invisibility.

episodes.title: La chica de las cien pulseras
episodes.summary: Kiri struggles to visit Capi, who begins to tell of his problems at high school.

episodes.title: El chico avispa
episodes.summary: Capi tells how he got the power to make himself invisible by going the MM's party: the Olympics.

episodes.title: El chico de la cicatriz en la ceja
episodes.summary: Capi, with the power to become invisible, distances himself from his friends, especially Zaro.

episodes.title: El chico de la herida en el pecho
episodes.summary: Guilt eats away at MM, who isolates himself, as the school begins to investigate the accident.

episodes.title: La chica del dragón en la espalda
episodes.summary: Capi tells the truth about his accident. The teacher unveils the mystery of the dragon on her back.
